fact: The Namibia Statistics Agency published the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2023/24-2026/27 in February 2023, with a four-year implementation plan costed at N$58,995,000 across ten sector statistics plans; the document gives no separate adoption date, so its publication date is used.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2023-2027.
Namibia Statistics Agency names the Namibia Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2023/4-2026/7 as the country's national strategy.
